svg.title: Essential form: the defining structure within the whole
svg.desc: Chapter 11, Hebrew p225, English p226. An outer square encloses four corner brackets, which frame a substantial solid inner square. Following user feedback, the inner square is twice its original width and the brackets move outward, making the center read as the defining structure of the larger whole. Ramchal explicitly identifies essential form with the subject's essence. This separate contextual icon does not assert a literal anatomical skeleton, a material component, or a philosophical distinction from essence.
